'''Vollen Sor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] in [[3653 BBY]]. Sor and [[Keevo]], his [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] Padawan, were on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Alderaan peace conference]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the peace conference, Sor and Keevo witnessed [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aryn Leneer]] leave the planet to seek revenge for her [[Death/Legends|deceased]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]], [[Ven Zallow]], who had died at the hands of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|What are you doing, Aryn?''"<br />"''I already told you, Vollen. Something for Master Zallow.|Vollen Sor and Aryn Leneer|<ref name="Deceived" />}}
Vollen Sor was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in service to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Sor and [[Keevo]], his [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], were both on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Alderaan peace conference|peace negotiations]] between the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]<ref name="Deceived" /> in [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">According to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the end of the [[Great Galactic War]], which was concurrent with the [[skirmish in the Yinta Lake spaceport]], occurred in [[3653 BBY]].</ref> They were in the [[Eeseen spaceport]] when rogue Jedi Knight [[Aryn Leneer]] was preparing to leave Alderaan to avenge her [[Master]] [[Ven Zallow]], who had recently [[Death/Legends|died]] at the hands of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]].<ref name="Deceived" />

When Sor asked her what she was doing, she simply stated that she was doing something for Zallow. Sor, Keevo, and Leneer talked for a while in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], and Leneer said farewell and prepared to leave. Sor and Keevo followed her to her [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to find out what she was doing, but Leneer would not tell them. Leneer removed her [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]], signifying her departure as someone other than a Jedi, and told Sor to tell Master [[Dar'Nala]], a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] at the peace negotiations, that she was sorry. After Leneer left, Sor picked up her robes with the same delicacy he would use to bear a fallen comrade.<ref name="Deceived" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|But negotiating with the Sith is madness.|Vollen Sor|<ref name="Deceived" />}}
Vollen Sor was a considerate Jedi Knight who saw hope for the Republic even though he thought that negotiating with the Sith was madness. He was concerned for Leneer when he found out that she was leaving Alderaan and going away as a being other than a Jedi. He was so distraught when she left, that he picked up her robes that she had left with the care that one would use for a comrade who had fallen in battle.<ref name="Deceived" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vollen Sor appeared in [[Paul S. Kemp]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'' published in [[2011]].<ref name="Deceived" />
